_description: Recommended contract name bases per provider - the core product names to keep after removing duration, type, and variants
_usage: Use these bases to replace/normalize contract names. The 'primary_bases' are high-confidence core product names. Apply in order of specificity (most specific patterns first).
_note: Based on analysis of contracts.json, contract_variants.json, contract_durations.json, and contract_types.json

AllureNRG.notes: Contract distinguishes solar (met zonnepanelen) vs non-solar; keep base without this distinction

primary_bases: Nederlandse Wind Stroom en CO2-gecompenseerd Gas
Budget Energie.notes: Remove duration (1/2/3 jaar), type (Vast/Variabel), customer segment (Verlenging), and letter codes (A/B/C/E/etc)

Cleanenergy.notes: Customer segment adds specificity (Huishoudelijk/Particulier/Consument/MKB/Zakelijk) - keep these. Remove duration, type, variants (Actie/Welkom/Loyaliteitsbonus), and channel markers

Coolblue Energie.notes: Coolblue uses distinct product names as bases. Remove duration (1/2/3/5 jaar, halfjaar, etc), type (Zeker, variabel), partners (Ziggo, ING), and variants

primary_bases: DELTA Groene Stroom en/of DELTA Gas
DELTA Groene Actiestroom en/of DELTA Actiegas
DELTA Puur Zeeuws Groen en/of DELTA MixGroen Gas
DELTA energie.notes: Uses parenthetical duration format: vaste leveringsprijs (1 jaar) - remove the parenthetical part

primary_bases: Groene Stroom en Gas AltijdVoordeel Vast
Energiedirect.nl.notes: May have multiple product lines. Remove duration, type, variants, and single letter codes

Eneco.notes: Large portfolio. Customer segment (Particulier/Zakelijk) may be meaningful. Remove duration, type, segment markers (Verlenging/Werving), variants

Essent.notes: Product types may include Essent Klant, Zakelijk - capture as distinct bases if meaningful, otherwise normalize to primary base. Remove duration, type, variants

Greenchoice.notes: Package types (Plus/Compleet/Start) may be meaningful product differentiators. Remove duration, pricing tiers (150/200/250/etc), variants, loyalty bonuses

Greenchoice Zakelijk.notes: B2B offerings. Remove duration, type, customer segment markers, variants

Hezelaer Energy.notes: Regional provider, may have limited offerings

Mega.notes: Known for numeric pricing tiers (84, 85, 194, etc) - these are variants, not bases. Remove them along with duration/type

_implementation_guidance.step_1_identify_provider: Extract provider name from contract metadata
_implementation_guidance.step_2_look_up_bases: Get primary_bases list from this file for the provider
_implementation_guidance.step_3_match_contract: Check if contract name starts with any primary_base
_implementation_guidance.step_4_extract_base: If match found, use matched base. If no match, fall back to extract_contract_name_base()
_implementation_guidance.step_5_normalize: Store both raw contract_name and normalized contract_name_base
_implementation_guidance.fallback_strategy: If provider not in this file, use extract_contract_name_base() as before
_implementation_guidance.priority_order: Check longest/most specific bases first (e.g., 'Clean Energy Huishoudelijk' before 'Clean Energy')
